Several R06 contrarian registrations are now pre-decided by later results: H30's question-native retrieval thesis is refuted by H499 (+0.0076 at n=132), H29's wrong-merge-unrecoverable premise is contradicted by H546 (0/1,802 merged-away losers destroyed an attachment point), and H28's scramble null is jointly implied by H17+H545+H68.
